LESSON: BELIEF IN HIS

Grade: PP1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Belief in His

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Belief in His. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. mention the prophet’s name Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.) His name him) as a sign of love and (Suggested time: 2 lessons) short stories on prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.)
2. demonstrate love for prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.) by emulating his character recording or watching video recordings. Prophet Muhammad’s character (Al Amin – the trustworthy). writing activities such as colouring e.g. the Kaaba, palm trees etc related to the story of the prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.).

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. mention the prophet’s name Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.) His name him) as a sign of love and (Suggested time: 2 lessons) short stories on prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.)

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Belief in His.
2. Explain Belief in His to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Belief in His.
4. Show that you can: mention the prophet’s name Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.) His name him) as a sign of love and (Suggested time: 2 lessons) short stories on prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.)
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Belief in His. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Belief in His important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. mention the prophet’s name Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.) His name him) as a sign of love and (Suggested time: 2 lessons) short stories on prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.)
2. demonstrate love for prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.) by emulating his character recording or watching video recordings. Prophet Muhammad’s character (Al Amin – the trustworthy). writing activities such as colouring e.g. the Kaaba, palm trees etc related to the story of the prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.).

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
